reason: I already reorder my Toplux when it runs out and I'm not looking to switch. My doctor said my magnesium could be low, so it's tempting, but I'd probably just ask her what to take and pick up whatever she says.
objection: Sachets feel like more packaging waste, a foil sachet every day for 30 days, and I already have a brand I trust and reorder.
would_change_my_mind: If my doctor's blood test showed I was actually low and she said this kind of magnesium was what I needed, or if it came in a refill pouch or bottle with less packaging.
